name: Chemchemal-Erbil industrial gas supply pipeline
monitor_reason: Fails add-threshold legs (a) and (b). (a) No identified sponsor: the only wording anywhere is 'new pipelines are to be built by private-sector companies' -- the companies are unnamed; Pearl Petroleum (Dana Gas/Crescent) is the gas seller under the GSA, not stated as the pipeline builder. (b) Endpoints not established: the delivery point is Van Steel Company in Erbil governorate, but no source gives an origin, route, length, or diameter -- 'Chemchemal-Erbil' is an inferred name, and it is equally plausible the Erbil supply arrives as a tie-in/spur off the existing Khor Mor-Erbil corridor (GEM P4047, 36-in, construction) rather than a standalone Chemchemal-Erbil trunk. (c) is only partially met: the 10-year GSA with Van Steel (signed Jan 2026, first gas H2 2027) is a concrete commercial step for the gas supply, but there is no tender, FEED, or EPC award for the pipeline itself. Contrast: the sibling Bazian line IS specified (dedicated 40 km, Chemchemal field direct to Bazian) in the same release, showing the sponsors describe pipelines concretely when they exist as defined projects -- the Erbil leg deliberately is not.
researcher_notes: Vetted 2026-07-04 (CB). Sole primary source is the 26 Jan 2026 Dana Gas/Crescent Petroleum (Pearl Petroleum) press release announcing 142 MMscf/d of 10-year GSAs from the Chemchemal field, with first gas H2 2027; Van Steel Company (Erbil governorate) is the sole Erbil offtaker named. On the pipeline serving Erbil the release says only that 'new pipelines are to be built by private-sector companies to supply gas to industrial users in Erbil and Bazian' -- no builder, origin, route, length, diameter, cost, or schedule. All other coverage checked (World Oil, Iraqi News, Egypt Oil & Gas, Sharjah24, MEES, Rudaw) reprints the same release; zero independent corroboration of a distinct Erbil pipeline project, so tier = low / independent = false. Match-to-existing re-checked against the 54-row Iraq gas roster: not the same project as P4047 Khormor-Erbil Gas Pipeline (that is the Khor Mor-to-Erbil power corridor, already under construction pre-dating this GSA) and not P4053 Erbil-Duhok; but a tie-in delivering Chemchemal gas to Van Steel via the P4047 corridor cannot be ruled out -- if that materializes, the correct treatment is likely a note/spur on P4047, not a new row. Re-vet when a builder is named, an origin/route is disclosed, or a pipeline tender/EPC award appears (watch Dana Gas/Crescent releases and KRG MNR through 2026-2027 ahead of H2 2027 first gas). The two cited URLs passed scripts/url_verifier.py on 2026-07-04 (the rudaw.net/business/26012026-amp URL was dropped -- it 200s to a nav shell without the article text and failed verification). The concrete sibling (dedicated 40 km Chemchemal-Bazian line) is handled under its own candidate slug.
